title: Dogwood House:Cozy Hideaway near downtown
description:
Stay in walking distance to some of Nashville's favorite coffee shops, restaurants, and boutiques. Dogwood House is an inviting cottage in Nashville. Recently renovated in June 2018, new everything. 

4 Mi to Tootsies on Broadway Downtown
~10 Min Lyft/Cab/Uber
~$9 in Lyft* not including surge pricing

3 Mi to Vanderbilt on West End
~11 Min Lyft/Cab/Uber
~$11 in Lyft*

4.2 Mi to Titans Stadium
~13 Min Lyft/Cab/Uber
~$10 in Lyft*

City of Berry Hill STRP Permint: #2018-06-26-030

The space
Renovated in June 2018, this space was created specifically with a Nashville vacay in mind! Dogwood House is about creativity and relaxation. All art in the house come from various Nashville Artists, for more information about the art please contact the Host.

Bedroom 1: King Bed, Closet and Dresser

Bedroom 2: Queen Bed, Closet.

Suite: 2 Queen Beds, extra large bathroom, closet, changing area.

Living Room: Queen Pull out Sofa

Guest access
You will have access to the entire home, from the front door and roll up door. Remote access will not be provided, however keys and codes will be provided as necessary.
